title: Finite candidate distribution
statement: Let $A$ be a finite set of elements of a type with decidable equality, and let $a_0$ be a default element of that type. The finite candidate distribution is uniform on $A$ when $A$ is nonempty, and is concentrated at $a_0$ when $A$ is empty.
hypotheses_covered: Decidable equality on the candidate type
A default element of the candidate type
